package handler

import (
	db "example.com/card-rpg-practice/db"
	"example.com/card-rpg-practice/game/cardrpg"
	runentity "example.com/card-rpg-practice/game/entities/card_run"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"time"
)

type ICardPlayerEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
}
type ICardRunEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.CardRunDao
	TimerComp() *runentity.TimerComponent
}

// Bootstrap 是受信任的首登入口；密钥来自服务端 crypto/rand，不能让客户端指定或投影给客户端。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardInit(player ICardPlayerEntity, key string, now int64) (cardrpg.ProfileView, error) {
	if player.Dao().GetState() != "" {
		p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
		if err != nil {
			return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
		}
		if p.DrawKey != key {
			return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
		}
		return p.View(), nil
	}
	p, err := cardrpg.NewProfile(key, now)
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	return p.View(), nil
}

// Rules 由端点捕获 configdata Snapshot 后传入，仅是内部业务参数，不是公网协议字段。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardDraw(player ICardPlayerEntity, seq uint64, count int, rules cardrpg.Rules) (cardrpg.DrawReceipt, error) {
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.DrawReceipt{}, err
	}
	receipt, err := p.Draw(seq, count, rules)
	if err != nil {
		return receipt, err
	}
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	return receipt, nil
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardManage(player ICardPlayerEntity, command cardrpg.Manage, rules cardrpg.Rules, now int64) (cardrpg.ProfileView, error) {
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	if err := p.Manage(command, rules, now); err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	return p.View(), nil
}

// 体力、开局顺序身份、冻结的编队和 Run 一起提交。Player 保持静态 sid，Run 由同一原服承载。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardStart(player ICardPlayerEntity, run ICardRunEntity, seq uint64, stage int, rules cardrpg.Rules, now int64) (int64, error) {
	if !entity.MatchEntityID(run.ID(), runentity.EntityKindCardRun) || !cardrpg.ValidTime(now) {
		return 0, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if seq > 0 && seq <= uint64(len(p.Runs)) {
		old := p.Runs[seq-1]
		if old.Stage != stage {
			return 0, cardrpg.ErrRule
		}
		return old.RunID, nil
	}
	if seq == 0 || seq != uint64(len(p.Runs))+1 || len(p.Runs) >= cardrpg.LedgerLimit || p.ActiveRun != 0 || stage < 1 || stage > 3 || stage > 1 && p.Clears[stage-2] == 0 || rules.Validate() != nil || run.Dao().GetState() != "" {
		return 0, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	if err := p.Regenerate(now); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if p.Energy < rules.Stages[stage-1].Energy {
		return 0, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	units, err := p.TeamUnits(rules)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	b, err := cardrpg.NewBattle(player.ID(), run.ID(), seq, stage, rules, units, p.BattleSeed(seq), now)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	p.Energy -= rules.Stages[stage-1].Energy
	p.ActiveRun = run.ID()
	p.Runs = append(p.Runs, cardrpg.Admission{Seq: seq, RunID: run.ID(), Stage: stage, ConfigHash: rules.Hash()})
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	return run.ID(), saveCardBattle(run, b)
}

// saveCardBattle 在 Nest 锁内持久化下一回合期限；替换定时器 ID，使旧回调不能推进新回合。
func saveCardBattle(run ICardRunEntity, b cardrpg.Battle) error {
	if old := run.Dao().GetTurnTimer(); old != 0 {
		run.TimerComp().RemoveTimer(old)
		run.Dao().SetTurnTimer(0)
	}
	run.Dao().SetState(b.Encode())
	if b.State.Status == "running" {
		id := run.TimerComp().NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(b.State.Deadline), runentity.TimerTurn, int64(b.NextSeq()), 0, nil)
		if id == 0 {
			return cardrpg.ErrRule
		}
		run.Dao().SetTurnTimer(id)
	}
	return nil
}

// 公网玩家入口只传已鉴权 PlayerID；不接收 ActorID=0 的 server-only 超时或敌方控制命令。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardTurn(run ICardRunEntity, actorID int64, command cardrpg.TurnCommand, now int64) (cardrpg.BattleView, error) {
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(run.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	if actorID != b.OwnerID || command.ActorID != actorID {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	before := len(b.Log)
	if err := b.Apply(command, now); err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	if len(b.Log) != before {
		if err := saveCardBattle(run, b); err != nil {
			return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
		}
	}
	return b.View(), nil
}

// 服务器敌方 AI 入口不暴露为客户端 endpoint；超时由持久 TimerComponent 驱动。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardEnemy(run ICardRunEntity, expected uint64, now int64) (cardrpg.BattleView, error) {
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(run.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	before := len(b.Log)
	if err := b.Apply(cardrpg.TurnCommand{Seq: expected, Kind: "enemy"}, now); err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	if len(b.Log) != before {
		if err := saveCardBattle(run, b); err != nil {
			return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
		}
	}
	return b.View(), nil
}

// 同一 Run 与 Player 的奖励、首通、星级、任务进度和领奖事实同事务，不信任客户端报胜或奖励数值。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardClaim(player ICardPlayerEntity, run ICardRunEntity) (cardrpg.ProfileView, error) {
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(run.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	if b.OwnerID != player.ID() || b.RunID != run.ID() || b.AdmissionSeq == 0 || b.AdmissionSeq > uint64(len(p.Runs)) || b.State.Status == "running" {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	admission := &p.Runs[b.AdmissionSeq-1]
	if admission.RunID != b.RunID || admission.ConfigHash != b.ConfigHash || admission.Stage != b.Stage || admission.Claimed != b.Claimed {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	if b.Claimed {
		return p.View(), nil
	}
	if p.ActiveRun != run.ID() {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	if b.State.Status == "won" {
		stage := b.Rules.Stages[b.Stage-1]
		reward := stage.Gold
		if p.Clears[b.Stage-1] == 0 {
			reward += stage.FirstGold
		}
		if p.Gold > cardrpg.ValueLimit-reward || p.Dust >= cardrpg.ValueLimit || p.Wins >= cardrpg.ValueLimit {
			return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
		}
		p.Gold += reward
		p.Dust++
		p.Wins++
		p.Clears[b.Stage-1] = max(p.Clears[b.Stage-1], b.Stars())
	}
	admission.Claimed = true
	b.Claimed = true
	p.ActiveRun = 0
	player.Dao().SetState(p.Encode())
	run.Dao().SetState(b.Encode())
	return p.View(), nil
}

// 读取也经正式锁边界，防止并发修改时直接从实体指针复制撕裂的视图。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardProfile(player ICardPlayerEntity) (cardrpg.ProfileView, error) {
	p, err := cardrpg.DecodeProfile(player.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.ProfileView{}, err
	}
	return p.View(), nil
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerCardBattle(run ICardRunEntity, actorID int64) (cardrpg.BattleView, error) {
	b, err := cardrpg.DecodeBattle(run.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, err
	}
	if b.OwnerID != actorID {
		return cardrpg.BattleView{}, cardrpg.ErrRule
	}
	return b.View(), nil
}
